explication: Open WebUI is a self-hosted, provider-agnostic AI workspace. The principal workflow is: a user submits a conversation in the web client; the backend authenticates and resolves the selected model, persists chat state, optionally augments context through files, local RAG, web search, memory, or tools, then streams the model result back over HTTP/WebSocket. The repository also documents channels, automations, calendars, pipelines, analytics, image/audio features, and enterprise provisioning. Some connections are inferred from documented product structure because only sampled excerpts were available.
